Subject: POC / Trial planning: success criteria, timelines, RACI (HorizonCare)

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Per our discovery, I wanted to capture the next steps and propose a concise POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. High level: HorizonCare wants to validate inference latency and integration with your patient routing workflow, confirm data isolation controls, and measure cost per 1k tokens for typical call transcripts.

Proposed success criteria (first pass):
- Latency: median tail-95 latency <= 350ms for 2k token context for the real-time summarization route.
- Throughput: support 40 concurrent sessions with <10% degradation in median latency.
- Data controls: logs and records retained in your VPC; no customer data persisted in Redwood-hosted analytics.
- Quality: extractive summary F1 >= 0.78 on your evaluation set (sheet attached).

Suggested timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): sign mutual action plan and deliver evaluation prompt set + sample transcripts (you).
- Week 1: Redwood provision trial tenant (Dedicated pool), deploy model variant; infra owner (Dev) to share network requirements.
- Week 2: Integration + end-to-end tests (Horizon devs + Redwood).
- Week 3: Evaluation run and metrics review; decision point.

RACI (ownership highlights) — rough, please review:
- App integration (SDKs/webhooks): HorizonCare devs (R), Redwood Eng (C/A) — Owner: Tom
- Infra / VPC networking: HorizonCare infra (R), Redwood Private enablement (C) — Owner: Dev Patel (Redwood) for config steps
- Security/compliance review: HorizonCare security (R), Irene (Redwood) C/A for evidence and controls
- Procurement / Purchase order: HorizonCare procurement (R), Rishi (Redwood) Sells/Finance (C)

Please review and confirm who on your side will own the sample data delivery and network kickoff. I've attached a success-criteria spreadsheet and a simple RACI template — I'll populate after your confirmation.

Next step: Emily, can you confirm acceptance of the proposed criteria and who will be the POC for data/network?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can provide a representative set of 500 de-identified call transcripts by EOD Monday (Week 0). Owner: me.
- POC for network & infra: Tom will take lead scheduling a network kickoff with your infra team; preferred window next Tue/Wed.
- Security evidence: our Security team will need SOC2 plus encryption-in-transit details; please have Irene share the relevant doc links and a short checklist.

A couple notes on success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable for the summarization path, but for live transcription-postflow we may want a 500ms tail-95 allowance. We'll run both metrics in the evaluation sheet. Also please include cost estimates on the same spreadsheet at the per-hour and per-1k token level so procurement can scope budget.

We'll review the RACI template after the network kickoff.

—Emily

I'll update the RACI matrix with the internal owners (Dev: Infra setup, Aditya: runtime tuning & kernel selection, Irene: security evidence, Rishi: billing/procurement) and share back.
